author: TheOpAmerican
body:
In-game name: At the time I was banned, J_ake, recently changed to my current handle.

Banned for: Official reason is autoclicker, however it was initially a temporary ban until I requested a permanent ban so I could take a leave from the server. (Note: All of this occurred before autoclicking was a instant ban.)

Why should I be unbanned: Well, one I requested my ban from Peacheh. Two, I don't believe there is any evidence of me autoclicking.

PROOF OF REQUESTED BAN:

[28/07/2015 5:41:30 PM] whisk1337: https://avicus.net/captainmcsalt#infractions ban please
[28/07/2015 5:40:51 PM] Peachy: ip match is over 50%
[28/07/2015 5:40:56 PM] Peachy: what’s your relation to him?
[28/07/2015 5:41:30 PM] whisk1337: it's me
[28/07/2015 5:41:49 PM] whisk1337: if you could perm ban my main account that would be great
Response to denied appeal:
 1) I never ban evaded my autoclicker ban. I'll still have my brother type up an appeal, both accounts that were "ban evaded" are his. I don't know who is saying that I ban evaded during the Cacalmarin BC scrim because I didn't. I was never there. 2) I'll send screenshots of my chat with Peachy. He never replied, but I'm assuming that he got the message since my autoclicker ban was changed to permanent. Which I may add was changed to a permanent ban before Autoclicking became a permanent ban offense. (seen here: avicus.net/forums/f86fd52f0 thread created on August 4th, ban issued on July 28.) 3) If there is any actual evidence of me using an autoclicker, please show me. If there is no proof you cannot keep me banned.
Proof that the chat with Peachy actually exists:
http://imgur.com/j3sT0hd

Hello, 

I will appeal this punishment, as your story does seem pretty reliable. I talked to you on Skype earlier about helping your brother out with his appeal, and taking that into consideration, it can be used to double check your claims.

Regards,
Pelpelajax,
Avicus Network Senior Moderator.
